newsitem.title: UK: Ivory Coast total 96/97 cocoa crop below 1 mln tns.
newsitem.headline: Ivory Coast total 96/97 cocoa crop below 1 mln tns.

text.p: The Ivory Coast's 1996/97 cocoa crop will be below one million tonnes and it has already sold around 800,000 tonnes, the country's Commodities Minister Alain Gauze said.
It has no more to sell, he said to journalists at an International Cocoa Organization (ICCO) meeting here.
"The crop is going to be less than one million tonnes this year," Gauze said.

"The weather has been very dry despite reports it has been raining recently....We don't call this rain,' he said. The country was aiming to locally process around 300,000 tonnes of cocoa in 1997. Local capacity is currently 200,000 tonnes but we are working on increasing this, Gauze said.

Private estimates for the 96/97 Ivory Coast cocoa crop have been as high as 1.1 million tonnes while the government's official crop forecast, including mid-crop, published in December was 950,000 tonnes.
